capabilities: Create file or virtual sub-notes from the editor context menu or command palette
Embed existing vault notes as sub-notes through a searchable picker
Edit sub-note Markdown inline from the rendered card or open the full editor
Fold and unfold sub-notes with a configurable default state and shared color
Copy Markdown with embedded sub-note references resolved to raw content
disambiguation: Not an outliner or folder-structure tool; sub-notes are framed cards rendered and edited inside a parent note.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation requires building the plugin from source.
problem: Obsidian embeds are read-only views of other files, with no way to create, edit, and fold small sub-notes inline within a parent note.
summary: Plugin that creates and manages lightweight sub-notes embedded inside a parent note, as file embeds or virtual Markdown blocks.
